title: N Seoul Tower
geometryBasis: The relation and aligned OSM building parts establish the podium perimeter, axis and two observation-deck radii. Operator dimensions control total height.
sectionBasis: The photographer’s exact 29 September 2026 original shows the form and finish above the trees. The operator supplies 135.7 m body and 101 m antenna dimensions. OSM part heights are approximate controls for the public deck bands.
limitations: Glazing divisions, podium cladding, antenna bracing and equipment details are generalized.
The model depicts the integral tower and podium exterior. It omits the separate neighboring lattice tower, paths and plaza shelters.
